items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Bass, Ralph Bass had his thing going, with his Jazz concerts.

ctx.x: I mean, it started with Jazz At The Philharmonic, and then it caught on with all the other... Just Jazz.
Gene Norman's affairs. Somebody else... Bass, Ralph Bass had his thing going, with his Jazz concerts. But overall, that was about it.
